title: Qualitative Data Analysis and Software
summary: Qualitative analysis approaches; qualitative data analysis software (MATLAB and related tools).
objectives: Explain the role of QDA software.
Distinguish software support from researcher judgement.
revision: Qualitative data analysis: coding → themes → interpretation. Software supports coding/retrieval/visualisation but does not replace researcher judgement.
traps: Software supports coding and visualisation; researcher interprets.

notes.t: Qualitative data analysis involves organising, coding and interpreting non-numerical data such as interview transcripts, field notes and documents to identify themes and patterns.

i: MATLAB — numerical and qualitative data handling.
Software supports coding, retrieval and visualisation of qualitative data.
Theme identification — grouping codes into themes.

notes.t: QDA software supports but does not replace researcher judgement. UGC NET may ask about the role of software in qualitative analysis.

mnemonics.title: CTI
mnemonics.text: C — Coding, T — Themes, I — Interpretation.
